hero.headline: Built in New York. Driven by purpose.
hero.sub: We are building more than a cricket team. A home for talent, character, leadership, and belonging through the game we love.
hero.imageAlt: New York Titans players and youth members posing together on the field in New York in 2025.

missionStrip: Talent. Character. Community. That is what Titans is built to grow.

pillars.title: Compete
pillars.body: We play to win, never at the cost of integrity, respect, or sportsmanship.

pillars.title: Develop
pillars.body: We invest in growth on and off the field through discipline, teamwork, and leadership.

pillars.title: Serve
pillars.body: We use cricket to build community, open opportunity, and create a place people are proud to belong to.

sponsor.heading: Partner with a club building real impact.
sponsor.body: Sponsoring Titans is more than logo placement. It is an opportunity to support youth development, leadership, and a growing cricket culture in New York.

story.heading: Building something bigger than match day.
story.body: Cricket can develop skill, confidence, character, and community. That is why Titans is not just about competition. It is about creating a standard, building pride, and giving players and families a place where they feel they belong.

join.heading: Join Titans
join.body: Whether you are a player, coach, volunteer, or supporter, there is a place for people who believe in discipline, growth, and community.

conduct.line: We hold ourselves to a written standard.
